template.name: Controller

query.comment: Deadlock freedom: the system never gets permanently stuck.
SAFETY (core): never a North-South car and an East-West car crossing at the same time. This is the conflict-freedom property (FR-06).
SAFETY (capacity): never more than c cars crossing at once (the M/M/c rule, FR-02).
Reachability: a North-South vehicle can actually cross.
Reachability: an East-West vehicle can actually cross.

Reachability (M/M/2 benefit): two SAME-axis cars can cross together. With c=2 this should be SATISFIED; with c=1 it should NOT be satisfied. This single query demonstrates the M/M/1 vs M/M/2 difference.
SAFETY: two CONFLICTING cars (different axes) never cross together, regardless of c.
Liveness/response: a waiting North-South vehicle eventually crosses.
Liveness/response: a waiting East-West vehicle eventually crosses.
